description.en: Writes a line of English under every prompt in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a translation when the prompt is in another language, or corrections and alternative phrasings when it is in English. Phrases it teaches go into a vocabulary book reviewed with /vocab. Display-only: nothing is added to the conversation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的每条 prompt 下方写一行英文：用其他语言写的给出译文，用英文写的给出纠错和替代说法。教过的说法收进生词本，用 /vocab 复习。只做展示，不往对话里加任何内容。
